features.name: Project agent harness foundation
features.description: Maintain restartable task state, focused scope boundaries, and a fail-fast verification entrypoint for coding-agent work.
doneCriteria: Root instructions route agents to state, verification, scope, and handoff artifacts.
Feature state, progress log, and handoff template are version-controlled.

features.name: Business workspace V2
features.description: Manage the proposal-to-delivery workflow with suppliers, materials, schedules, and funnel reporting.
doneCriteria: Proposal, review, supplier assignment, material confirmation, and delivery scheduling work end to end.

features.name: Offline Chinese PDF font support
features.description: Provide a local Chinese font subset so PDF exports remain reliable when external font retrieval is unavailable.
doneCriteria: A licensed local subset font is included and configured as an export fallback.
A Chinese PDF export is verified with network access disabled.

features.name: CI coverage artifact and threshold
features.description: Publish coverage evidence in CI and enforce an agreed coverage threshold.
doneCriteria: CI fails below the documented coverage threshold.
